channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Shai Gilgeous-Alexander | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Shai Gilgeous-Alexander from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Bennett Stirtz on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
item.description:
Bennett Stirtz:

“Whatever the team needs me to win, I’m going to do. It’s easier when you have the best player in the world (Shai Gilgeous-Alexander) out there to make the game easier for you. Whatever I can do to help everyone else, I’ll do it.”

Bennett Stirtz on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Oct 10, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Jared McCain on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
item.description:
Jared McCain on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander:

“For me, it was seeing how he was just in the off-season in general, off the court kind of stuff. He really keeps it simple and I really admire that and how much of a family man he is. A lot of it was just kind of seeing I worked with his strength coach out there and being able to see just that on-court, off-court, what time we were waking up and being able to work out with him was really cool for me.”

Jared McCain on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Oct 8, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Draymond Green on LeBron James, Kawhi Leonard, Nikola Jokic, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
item.description:
Draymond Green:

“We all get a licensing check. LeBron James, Steph Curry, Kawhi Leonard, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Nikola Jokic, they all get the same jersey sales as the rookie. Excuse me, as a rookie, you don't get a license check because the license check is from a year before. But say a second-year guy who didn't play much on a team, and the license check was 500 grand, that's jersey sales. That's all of the licensing things, right? That same 500 grand that that second-year guy gets, Steph Curry gets. It's divvied up, it's even split. And so, you could make 300,000, you could make 500,000, but every player makes the same amount.”

Draymond Green on LeBron James, Kawhi Leonard, Nikola Jokic, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Sep 11, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Draymond Green on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
item.description:
The Draymond Green Show: Draymond on SGA's Foul-Baiting And Flopping

“Shai, you've reached a new level of greatness my man... you got sports media coming out and talking about what they don't like about your greatness, as if Shai Gilgeous-Alexander is running up and down the court with the whistle in his mouth calling a foul for himself... you all think the NBA is that easy to where this guy just flops and goes to the free throw line and he becomes the back to back MVP?We really gonna dumb the NBA down to that?”

Draymond Green on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, May 30, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
item.description:
Mark Daigneault:

“At the end of the day, there’s no player I'd rather have on the team than Shai Gilgeous-Alexander in Game 7 in the Western Conference finals.”

Mark Daigneault on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, May 30, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
item.description:
Daigneault on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, not forcing anything and staying even-keeled:

“His poise and confidence is contagious. It's only been more contagious as his gravity has grown over time. I give him a lot of credit for the way that he has not fought the game in this series.”

Mark Daigneault on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, May 10, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Kawhi Leonard on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
item.description:
Kawhi Leonard on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander:

“He’s been doing great. Flowers to him and the way he works and keeps his body healthy to come in every game and play and be very consistent.”

Kawhi Leonard on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Apr 9, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mike Brown on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
item.description:
Mike Brown on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander:

“His ability to control his body. His body control is amazing, not only that. He knows when to attack, how to attack and who to attack and then he still has the awareness of where everybody is on the floor.”

Mike Brown on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Mar 30, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Victor Wembanyama on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Nikola Jokic, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
item.description:
Speaking with ESPN, Victor Wembanyama was asked who the NBA’s best player is:

“Jokić is the best offensive player … I don’t think he’s the best player. (It’s) between Giannis (Antetokounmpo) and Shai (Gilgeous-Alexander). “When I come back to the court, it will be me.”

Victor Wembanyama on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Nikola Jokic, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Dec 12, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
item.description:
“The versatility, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander — the versatility of these guys is what allows us to be really, really, broad in what we do,”

Mark Daigneault on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Dec 10, 2025. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Ja Morant on Pascal Siakam, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Jalen Williams
item.description:
“Instead of focusing on the performances we seen from Jdub/Shai [Jalen Williams and Shai Gilgeous-Alexander], Tj/Siakam [T.J. McConnell and Pascal Siakam], how this series is going,”

Ja Morant on Pascal Siakam, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Jalen Williams, Jun 17, 2025. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Danny Green on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
item.description:
“A lot of people are not happy or disappointed with how many threes are being taken and that we don’t have traditional back-to-the-basket games anymore, post-ups and go with big men, and have mid-range games. And it was kind of being pushed out of the game and becoming obsolete.“So the fact that (Gilgeous-Alexander and others), they mix up their game and they make sure that they continue to not only improve, but show how important it is to be able to score on all levels, to be able to defend and to do all the other little things that matter, outside of shooting the ball from the three-point line.”

Danny Green on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Jun 4, 2025. Source: Toronto Sun.

item.title: Vasilije Micic on Kevin Durant, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
item.description:
Vasilije Micic:

“There are top players over there. Definitely unique when it comes to talent. Work ethic. The guy [Shai Gilgeous-Alexander] who just became MVP was always first in practice. Great leader. The Joker is the same. Kevin Durant, I had a chance of working with him the last two months and see his way of working.”

Vasilije Micic on Kevin Durant, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, May 29, 2025. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Chris Paul on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
item.description:
“You see Lu finally make his first all-defensive team. And getting to take this game in with [Gilgeous-Alexander’s wife], I’m happy for him.”

Chris Paul on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, May 23, 2025. Source: Andscape.

item.title: Chris Finch on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
item.description:
Jon Krawczynski:Chris Finch on the player frustration with Shai Gilgeous-Alexander calls:

“There was a lot of frustration out there. We talked about that before the series started. We have to be able to put that to the side and get on with a next-play mentality.”

Chris Finch on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, May 21, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Mark Daigneault on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander:

“I always marvel at his ability to get himself back to zero after every game. It’s usually after a great game. When he does fail, he doesn’t pout. He doesn’t point fingers… He delivered big time for us down the stretch.”

Mark Daigneault on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, May 11, 2025. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Cason Wallace on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
item.description:
Joel Lorenzi:Cason Wallace on guarding Shai Gilgeous-Alexander:

“He doesn’t even know what he’s gonna do, so how can you know what he’s gonna do? I have no advice on guarding him.”

Cason Wallace on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Apr 1, 2025. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Jalen Williams on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Jalen Williams on how much it means to the team to see Shai Gilgeous-Alexander in the MVP race:

“It means a lot. Probably means more to us than him. At the same time, we’re all focused on winning. And winning solves a lot of those issues.”

Jalen Williams on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Mar 9, 2025. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
item.description:
Chris Hine:Anthony Edwards on his block of Shai Gilgeous-Alexander:

“That took everything out of me. What’s crazy, is I don’t even think I jumped that high. That’s what was crazy. When I blocked it I was definitely talking a lot of trash, for sure.”

Anthony Edwards on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Feb 25, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jalen Williams on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
item.description:
“I want to be a great player. Being around ‘2’ (Gilgeous-Alexander) makes me want to be more of a great player. I think I’m on the right track.”

Jalen Williams on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Jan 16, 2025. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
item.description:
Mark Daigneault on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander:

“You guys would be shocked at how little I coach him… He is the best person to drive his development plan. Because no one cares more about his game than he does.”

Mark Daigneault on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Nov 12, 2024. Source: x.com.

item.title: Sam Presti on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
item.description:
Sam Presti on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's possible future $80 million supermax:

“Good for him. That's a lot of money. He's earned that position. He has seized the moment and the opportunity. If Shai earns something like that, we need to be in position to provide that. And not at the expense of other players on the team.”

Sam Presti on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, May 28, 2024. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Sam Presti on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
item.description:
Sam Presti on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander:

“I think he's really proud of what he's built here. You're always going to sleep better in a house that you've built.”

Sam Presti on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, May 28, 2024. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Kyshawn George on Klay Thompson, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
item.description:
Kyshawn George:

“It’s tough for me because there’s a part of me that I always played point guard for 16 years, and now I’m developing to be a wing or shooting guard. I would want to say Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, but I don’t play directly like him. I would want to say Klay Thompson right now because I’m a shooting guard and behind the three-point line a lot, but I think I have more ball-handling creativity than him, so I can’t really tell you. I think I’m a mix of a bunch of players.”

Kyshawn George on Klay Thompson, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, May 21, 2024. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Gordon Hayward on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Gordon Hayward on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander:

“He was unreal. Not only the postseason, the entire year. To lead the team to the #1 seed in the West… He’ll only get better from these situations. He was tremendous.”

Gordon Hayward on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, May 19, 2024. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Luguentz Dort on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Lu Dort on whether he ever gets sick of being around Shai Gilgeous-Alexander between Thunder and Team Canada:

“No, that’s my dawg. You can’t get sick of this guy, he’s always smiling.”

Luguentz Dort on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, May 19, 2024. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Kevin Garnett on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
item.description:
“It’s a regular season award, and usually… The best player on your team usually represents the best team… I thought Shai [Gilgeous-Alexander] should have had [the MVP].”

Kevin Garnett on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, May 11, 2024. Source: Twitter @ClutchPointsApp.

item.title: Chet Holmgren on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
item.description:
ClutchPoints: Chet Holmgren on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander:

“He’s too humble to say it, but this is the MVP right here”

Chet Holmgren on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Apr 25, 2024. Source: Twitter @ClutchPointsApp.

item.title: Gordon Hayward on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
item.description:
Joel Lorenzi:Gordon Hayward on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander :

“Obviously a front runner for MVP this year. Well deserved. He’s put it in the work.”

Gordon Hayward on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Mar 13, 2024. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Jalen Williams on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
item.description:
Jalen Williams on defenders trying to guard Shai Gilgeous-Alexander:

“Yeah. I guard him in summer and at practice so I know exactly what they’re going through.”

Jalen Williams on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Jan 14, 2024. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.
